category_title: Latino/a students who avoid class participation due to fear of embarrassment or social anxiety
scenario_title: Class avoidance due to social anxiety
minimal_context: The student is expected to participate in a whole-class instruction session in a middle school classroom.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Alright everyone, we are going to start our whole-class discussion now. I will be calling on students to answer the questions on the board.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Can I go to the bathroom?

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We just started the lesson. Please take out your notebook and get ready to answer.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I don't understand how things work here. I really need to use the bathroom right now.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You need to stay in your seat and participate in the lesson with the rest of the class.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: She hates me, and I want to get out of her class. I'm leaving.
